title: Social video app tab bar with raised circular active tab
note_on_format: Supplied as a GIF with 1 frame only, so no animation is visible and none can be analyzed.

color.method: Pixel sampling via median-cut quantization of the supplied JPEG/GIF (compressed images, so values are approximate within a few units). Entries marked 'approx' were judged by eye, not sampled.
palette: active circle cyan (sampled, gradient to blue)
color.roles: Single-hue blue field; white bar; cyan gradient circle as the sole accent; slate-grey outline icons.

observed.layout: A phone silhouette fills the top; white bottom tab bar with 5 items (home, live, message, follow, personal). The active 'home' tab sits in a circle that rises above the bar with a concave cutout in the bar around it. Title 'TAB Bar Design - Social Video applications' below.
observed.hierarchy: Elevated gradient circle dominates; labels are small and light.
observed.typography: Title in bold italic condensed-style sans with speed lines (DIN-like; unconfirmed). Tab labels light, small.
observed.iconography: Rounded monoline icons with playful details (face for personal, smile for message); active icon filled white on cyan.
observed.materials: Soft gradients, soft shadow below the phone, glossy-light feel.

interpretation.aesthetic: Friendly, mid-2010s-to-2020 mobile app style with soft shadows and rounded forms.
implementation_notes: Notch/raised tab is usually an SVG path or a masked pseudo-element behind the bar; the circle translates between slots and the notch follows.
Gradient circle: linear-gradient(cyan to blue) with a soft drop shadow.
interpretation.caveat: Motion cannot be verified from this file.

concept_work.essence: The active tab physically rises out of the bar, so position and shape carry state.
what_makes_it_work: Single-color system keeps focus on the circle.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Raised tab eats vertical space and collides with safe-area/home-indicator zones.
Light grey labels on white fail contrast.
Notch geometry needs animating between 5 positions without jank.

lessons: Physical metaphors (rising, notching) give strong state cues but cost layout robustness.
